campuses.name: Stargate Argentina (OpenAI + Sur Energy, Patagonia)
campuses.powerNote: Up to 500 MW per the Oct 2025 letter of intent; first stage 100 MW planned near the Limay river in Confluencia, Neuquén (near El Chocón / Piedra del Águila hydro plants and Vaca Muerta). As of Oct 2026 no construction had started.
campuses.investmentNote: Up to US$25B per the Argentine government's 2025-10-10 announcement of a letter of intent between OpenAI and Sur Energy. OpenAI says it is only a potential buyer of compute; Sur Energy (co-founder Emiliano Kargieman) must assemble the investor consortium. One year on (Oct 2026) there was no firm contract, no investment and no RIGI filing; Kargieman said he hoped for a deal before end-2026, blamed OpenAI's global infrastructure review (which also paused Stargate UK), and added Fluidstack as technology partner.
